metadata.title: NEXO — Digital strategy & growth · Gran Canaria
metadata.description: NEXO is a digital strategy and growth studio. Strategy, marketing, content and technology working as one single system to grow businesses. Gran Canaria, without borders.

hero.support: Strategy, marketing, content and technology working as one single system to grow businesses.

statement.body: Strategy, marketing, content and technology work as one system. Sometimes the answer is a campaign; sometimes a website; sometimes custom software. Almost always, a combination.

technology.principle: Strategy first. Technology when it creates value.
technology.support: When the strategy requires a custom tool, we do not rely on generic solutions: we design and build it.

corazon.title: Corazón Napoletano
corazon.headline: A brand rethought around the customer experience.
corazon.support: We connected identity, content, menu, touchpoints and digital presence into one single system.
corazon.scope: Brand identity · Content · Menu + Upselling · QR · Website
corazon.resultNote: An integrated digital strategy, from the web experience to acquisition.

context.heading: Context
context.body: A restaurant needs more than an attractive website. Its digital presence must help people discover the brand, understand the offering, see the menu, make a decision, contact or book, and remember the restaurant.

steps.title: Digital presence
steps.body: Design and development of the website.

steps.title: Digital menu
steps.body: A menu experience designed to make the restaurant offering immediately accessible online.

steps.title: Acquisition
steps.body: Paid advertising campaigns through advertising platforms.

steps.title: Content
steps.body: Creation and publishing of digital content.

steps.title: Strategy
steps.body: Ongoing recommendations and strategic guidance based on the needs of the business and sector.

result.heading: Result
result.body: The combined strategy contributed to an increase of approximately 20% in revenue.

hero.support: Identity, content, menu, table experience and digital presence designed as one single system.

system.title: One system, from brand to result.

identity.heading: Before digital, we built the brand.
identity.body: A coherent identity, extended to every touchpoint — digital and physical.

content.heading: Show the real product.
content.body: Original social content shot in the restaurant — real food, real people.

menu.heading: The menu as a tool for choice and sales.
menu.body: Re-engineered, not just redesigned — clearer structure, guided choice, integrated upselling.

qr.heading: Less friction between table and choice.
qr.body: QR menu access that makes choosing easier — less friction, right at the table.

website.heading: A website that continues the experience.
website.body: The brand and the menu online — with booking and multilingual navigation.

result.label: Revenue increase
result.body: From the month following the introduction of the new system, Corazón Napoletano recorded a 20% increase in revenue.
result.nexo: The result does not come from a single channel. Identity, content, menu, upselling, table experience and digital presence were designed to work together.

hero.support: We connect strategy, marketing, content and technology around one business objective.

principle.line1: The solution doesn't start with the service.
principle.body: First, we understand what needs to change in the business. Sometimes the answer is a campaign. Sometimes it's a website, content or custom software. Most of the time, it's a well-orchestrated combination.

capabilities.title: Five capabilities. One system.
capabilities.support: We activate only what the objective requires. Each discipline can work independently or connect with the rest.

list.title: Digital strategy
list.description: We turn business goals into clear digital priorities: what to do, why it matters, where to invest and how to know whether it's working.

list.title: Paid media & growth
list.line: Invest with intent. Optimise with data.
list.description: We design and manage acquisition systems focused on results, connecting campaigns, messaging, creative and the conversion experience.
list.note: We evaluate other channels when the strategy justifies them.

list.title: Social & content
list.line: Content that builds the brand and drives action.
list.description: We define what to say, how to tell it and how to turn it into content that builds attention, trust and demand.

list.title: Web & digital experiences
list.description: We design and build fast, clear digital experiences that feel like the brand and are shaped around what users need to do.

list.title: Software & automation
list.line: When off-the-shelf doesn't fit, we build it.
list.description: We design custom digital tools when the process, business or experience needs something a standard solution cannot solve properly.
list.principle: Technology when it creates value. Not complexity for its own sake.

system.title: One objective. The right combination.
system.support: We don't force every service into every project. We design the system that makes sense for the problem we're solving.

examples.label: Acquisition
examples.support: Each point strengthens the next. The campaign creates attention; the digital experience turns that attention into measurable action.

examples.label: Operations
examples.support: When the problem isn't getting more attention but working better, we can design and build the technology that connects the process.

collaboration.title: A focused project or a team that stays with you.
collaboration.intro: The model follows the objective, not a fixed formula.

project.title: Project
project.body: For challenges with a defined scope: a new website, a platform, a strategy, a launch or a specific problem that needs solving.

continuous.title: Ongoing collaboration
continuous.body: For businesses that need to execute, measure and evolve continuously across content, campaigns, growth, digital products and optimisation.

process.title: Understand first. Build second.
process.support: Execution changes from project to project. The way we think doesn't.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: Business, context, customer, friction points and the real objective.

steps.title: Strategy
steps.description: We define priorities, channels, solution and success metrics.

steps.title: Create
steps.description: We design and produce what the system requires.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: We put campaigns, content, experiences or products into motion.

steps.title: Optimise
steps.description: We measure, learn and improve using real data.

cta.support: Tell us the objective. We'll help define what is worth creating, launching or improving.

hero.support: NEXO was born in Las Palmas to connect strategy, marketing, content and technology around businesses that want to move forward with direction.

origin.line1: The market didn't need another list of services.
origin.accent: It needed the existing pieces to work better together.
origin.body: We saw businesses with a strong product, identity and potential, but a fragmented digital presence: one person handling campaigns, another building the website, another creating content — and nobody connecting the decisions.
origin.body2: NEXO was born from that opportunity. Bring the pieces together, understand what the business actually needs and build a digital system that makes sense as a whole.

metrics.title: Data is useless if nobody turns it into decisions.
metrics.body: A client shouldn't receive a campaign, a chart and a list of metrics only to be left alone figuring out what to do with them.
metrics.body2: We measure to learn. We interpret to decide. And we decide to improve what comes next.
metrics.closing: The metric isn't the result. It's information that helps us reach it.

approach.title: From the first decision to what comes next.
approach.body: We can step in while a business is still taking shape or after it has been operating for years. The starting point changes; the responsibility doesn't.

new.label: From scratch
new.title: Build with clear direction from day one.
new.body: Positioning, identity, digital presence, acquisition, experience and technology can be designed as one system before disconnected decisions become difficult to change.

existing.label: Already moving
existing.title: Understand what's there and improve what actually matters.
existing.body: We analyse what's working, where value is being lost and what deserves to change before adding more actions, channels or tools.

approach.closing: We don't want to deliver one piece and disappear. We want to understand what happens after it starts moving.

principles.title: Judgement before noise.
principles.intro: Some decisions define how we want to work, regardless of the project.

list.title: If you don't need it, we'll say so.
list.body: We don't recommend a campaign, platform or automation simply because we can build it. The solution has to justify its existence.

list.title: Measure before assuming.
list.body: Opinions create hypotheses. Data helps test them. We'd rather learn from real behaviour than defend an intuition out of pride.

list.title: Less complexity.
list.body: A good solution should simplify something: a decision, an experience, a process or an operation.

list.title: No black boxes.
list.body: The client should understand what we're doing, why we're doing it, what we're seeing and what we recommend doing next.

list.title: Business first.
list.body: Reach, clicks and followers can be useful, but they're never the objective on their own. We connect them to outcomes that matter to the business.

list.title: Design for people.
list.body: Behind every conversion is someone trying to book, buy, decide or work. The experience has to work for that person.

team.title: Two disciplines. One direction.
team.intro: NEXO brings together two ways of looking at the same problem: how to make a brand grow and how to build the technology that makes it possible.

members.name: Alessandro
members.description: Works across positioning, identity, communication and growth: understanding what a brand should stand for and turning that direction into actions capable of generating demand.

members.name: Lorenzo
members.description: Turns business needs into digital products and systems: from web experiences to platforms, automation and custom software, with particular attention to architecture and security.
members.capabilities: Full Stack · Web · Software · Automation · Security

network.title: A small core. The specialists each project needs.
network.body: We don't believe in inflating a structure just to say everything happens in-house. NEXO keeps strategic direction and project responsibility, bringing in specialist profiles when the work requires them.
network.closing: One direction. The right team around it.

location.title: Based in Las Palmas. Looking beyond one island.
location.body: NEXO was born in Gran Canaria and can work with businesses across the archipelago. Being close helps us understand the context; thinking digitally keeps that context from becoming a limit.

cta.titleLine1: If something in your business should be working better,
cta.support: You don't need to arrive with the solution. Tell us what you want to change.
